rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the person in charge of a business or organization.

example.english: The manager isn't at the office today, so let's wait until they come back to decide anything.
example.traditional: 經理今日唔喺公司，有咩事等佢返嚟先決定啦。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 gam1 jat6 m4 hai2 gung1 si1 jau5 me1 si6 dang2 keoi5 faan1 lei4 sin1 kyut3 ding6 laa1

rows.note: Use this instead of 經理 when the person manages a shop, restaurant, or other individual branch.

example.english: I asked the manager, and this cake will only be in stock tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我問過店長，呢款蛋糕聽日先有貨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 man6 gwo3 dim3 zoeng2 ni1 fun2 daan6 gou1 ting1 jat6 sin1 jau5 fo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the head coach of a sports team.

example.english: The manager said we need to play faster in the next match.
example.traditional: 主教練話下場波要踢得再快啲。
example.jyutping: zyu2 gaau3 lin6 waa6 haa6 coeng4 bo1 jiu3 tek3 dak1 zoi3 faai3 di1

rows.note: Use this for the professional who manages a singer or musical group.

example.english: The singer said the manager negotiated several new jobs for them.
example.traditional: 個歌手話，經理人幫佢傾掂咗幾份新工作。
example.jyutping: go3 go1 sau2 waa6 ging1 lei5 jan4 bong1 keoi5 king1 dim6 zo2 gei2 fan6 san1 gung1 zok3
